authority: File Bridge score contract only. WebMCP is a separate API.

delivery.directories: HALO creates requests/ and responses/. Agents never create directories.
delivery.publication: Complete and read back companions first, publish and read back request last.
delivery.root: Verify one connected root containing AGENT_GUIDE.md, project-state.json, requests/ and responses/. Fix ROOT, STATE, ID, REQUEST and RECEIPT once.

score.shape: Exactly one of voices (phrase) or phrases + sections (song). Song creation requires replace. Song edit requires phraseId.

voices.creation: Every authored voice requires sound and exactly one of notes or steps. Omitted roles are silent.
voices.editing: Unmentioned voices and fields are preserved; changing sound is explicit.
voices.notes: [step, MIDI, ...] with unique steps, integer MIDI 0..127 and role polyphony from instruments.json.tracks.
voices.steps: Unique integer hits for unpitched timbres only; [] means intentional silence.
voices.controls: on is boolean; level, character, duration, space, delay, chorus are 0..100.

score.strict: Unknown fields, aliases, prefixed/case-variant sounds, operation envelopes and unsafe references are errors. No automatic revision rebasing.

receipts.identity: id equals ID; requestId, if supplied, equals the request basename.
receipts.freshness: After correction require a changed submissionVersion for pending/error. Matching applied/rejected are terminal.
receipts.checks: Read immediately; absent/stale only: built-in wait 4–5 seconds, at most 3 reads. Without wait tool: one immediate reread. Never shell waits.
receipts.approval: Receipt statuses are output only, never request commands. Only the HALO user can approve. Stop on pending_approval and invite human approval; never poll for it.
receipts.idLifecycle: Each later user musical change needs a new ID and live revision. Same ID is only for the current unfinished submission within the same turn. Reported pending, applied and rejected end it.
receipts.evidence: scoreAudit contains actual seconds, named keys, scale/pitch classes and per-role attacksPerBar. Counts are event starts, not sustain or musical quality. scoreReport warns PART_BAR_GAP for two or more consecutive bars without new notes in an active authored pitched part.
receipts.enforcement: HALO cannot police external receipt reads or file writes; those limits require the external tool adapter.
